values: If the shooter is riding a graugapult, we want to shoot the graugapult.
Drunk orcs will look drunk as long as they don't have their weapons out and the area is on low alarm.
Orcs will play hot animations while idling in areas of elevated temperatures or while pausing between working hard (with weapons sheathed).
If the shooter is a berserker, we want to do the berserker animation.
If the shooter is an olog, we want to do the olog animation.
Ologs can't squat, so we call the KneelR SmartObject instead. It contains an appropriate entry, exit, and loop animation for the Olog to use.
If the shooter is a goblin, we want to do the goblin animation.
If the shooter is a defender, we want to do the defender animation.
Orcs with torches will idle in a pose holding a torch.
Orcs at low alarm that have their weapons out will play an appropriate animation.
